title: Global run cap defaults to 2
lead: Owner decision 2026-10-31 (adj 172, `engine.default-cap`): the global run cap defaults to 2, not 4. The code and five documents still say 4.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The owner answered adj 172 with the option "two" in an interactive question on 2026-10-31. The 2026-10-26 orchestration trial ran slices one at a time with no stalls, and the earlier parallel stretch had three landing conflicts (docs/review-2026-10-26-orchestration-trial.md, O2). The owner can raise the cap per wave or in config (ork settings set --global-cap N). The default is the built-in value used when the registry sets none (see Files). adj 20 set 4 and adj 172 changes it. AGENTS.md says documents follow decided records.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/runs.go:46-47` (`defaultGlobalCap`) and `internal/daemon/runs.go:789-796` (`hasRoomLocked`).
- `internal/daemon/settings.go:126` (effective value when unset).
- `internal/daemon/settings_test.go:80` and `internal/daemon/settings_test.go:114` (both expect an effective cap of 4).
- `internal/daemon/daemon_test.go:1499` (sets `GlobalCap = 4` explicitly; check whether it relies on the default).
- `PROJECT.md:83`, `docs/design.md:231`, `docs/guide.md:153`, `docs/guide.md:302`, `docs/diagrams.md:146`, `docs/orchestrator-parity.md:71`.
- `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased entry).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- With no `global_cap` in the registry, `settings.get` reports an effective global cap of 2.
- With no `global_cap`, a third run queues while two are busy, and starts when one finishes.
- A registry that sets `global_cap` keeps that value.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first from the failing list. Update the two expectations in `internal/daemon/settings_test.go`.
2. Change `defaultGlobalCap` to 2 and its comment to cite adj 172.
3. Change every "4" in the listed documents that names the default. Do not touch a "4" that names the cache's 4-process cap or anything else.
4. Add a CHANGELOG entry in the style of the surrounding entries.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: `go test -race ./...`; `go vet ./...`; `gofmt -l .`; `slicer check`; `adj lint`; `rg -n "global cap.*4|default 4|defaults to 4" PROJECT.md docs` lists nothing that names the global cap.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch: "Global run cap defaults to 2".
